title: Woman woke up to see stranger invited into bedroom by husband, court hears
summary_full: Jury at Winchester crown court sees video evidence by Joanne Young, 49, in trial of four men accused of sexual assaultA woman who was allegedly sexually assaulted by men invited into their family home by her ex-husband described how she would wake in the middle of the night restrained and blindfolded and feeling “hazy”.Joanne Young said that on one occasion she managed to remove her blindfold and was shocked to glimpse a stranger in her bedroom who her husband, Philip Young, had allegedly arranged to have sex with her.
